entry.name: jit.gl.shader
entry.description: Manages the process of compiling, binding and submitting a shader to OpenGL. A shader consists of both a vertex program and a fragment (aka pixel) program, which can be defined in a xml shader description file (JXS), or submitted individually. Currently the high level language GLSL is supported.
